SELECT 
    pa.panemark,
    pr.perfregistry,
    ROUND(CAST(pr.measpoww / pa.powratew * 100 AS numeric), 2) AS ppr,
    pa.powratew * pa.tempcoef * (avg_env.avg_cell_temp - 25) AS tpci,
    ROUND(CAST(
        pr.measpoww / pa.powratew * 100 + (pa.powratew * pa.tempcoef * (avg_env.avg_cell_temp - 25)) / pa.powratew 
    AS numeric), 2) AS tapr
FROM performance pr
JOIN panel pa ON pr.solmodref = pa.panemark
JOIN (
    SELECT pa2.panemark, AVG(e.celltempc) AS avg_cell_temp
    FROM panel pa2
    JOIN plant pl ON pa2.hubregistry = pl.growregistry
    JOIN environment e ON pl.growregistry = e.arearegistry
    GROUP BY pa2.panemark
) avg_env ON pa.panemark = avg_env.panemark
LIMIT 5;

CREATE VIEW vw_panel_efficiency AS
SELECT 
    pa.panemark,
    pr.perfregistry,
    ROUND(CAST(pr.measpoww / pa.powratew * 100 AS numeric), 2) AS ppr,
    pa.powratew * pa.tempcoef * (avg_env.avg_cell_temp - 25) AS tpci,
    ROUND(CAST(
        pr.measpoww / pa.powratew * 100 + (pa.powratew * pa.tempcoef * (avg_env.avg_cell_temp - 25)) / pa.powratew 
    AS numeric), 2) AS tapr
FROM performance pr
JOIN panel pa ON pr.solmodref = pa.panemark
JOIN (
    SELECT pa2.panemark, AVG(e.celltempc) AS avg_cell_temp
    FROM panel pa2
    JOIN plant pl ON pa2.hubregistry = pl.growregistry
    JOIN environment e ON pl.growregistry = e.arearegistry
    GROUP BY pa2.panemark
) avg_env ON pa.panemark = avg_env.panemark;
